history.summary: An older (2002) freehold boutique in D15 with only 3 URA transactions on file — too thin to trust appreciation or exit. The $1,449 PSF on a roomy 1,173 sqft 3BR is reasonable for the district, but the tiny, illiquid development and 1km+ walk to MRT cap the investment case.
history.rating_rationale: D15 freehold at $1,449 PSF / $1.7M is fair value and sits in the liquid price band, but ura_txn_count of 3 makes appreciation unknowable and signals a thin-trading micro-development. Score_1000 of 554 is only market-typical. 13-min walk to Eunos MRT and a 24-year-old build limit tenant and resale appeal.
red_flags: Only 3 URA transactions — appreciation rate and exit liquidity both unverifiable
Likely small boutique development (illiquid, limited facilities)
catalysts: D15 freehold tenure and deep East Coast buyer pool
Lifestyle district with sustained owner-occupier demand
